findings.message: Timer start event "startCron" uses a cron expression, which needs Camunda 8.1 or newer; this model targets Camunda 1.2.
findings.suggestion: Use an ISO 8601 repeating interval (R/PT1H), or target Camunda 8.1 or newer.

findings.message: Signal start event "startSignal" needs Camunda 8.2 or newer; this model targets Camunda 1.2.
